reviews.text: Took our two kittens here for all of their early care - check-ups, shots, spay surgery & chipping. We are very happy with our choice. The clinic has a nice atmosphere and the staff treat animals with genuine care. All of our questions and concerns were addressed and our kittens are healthy and happy.
I am very happy with this practice; nice people and good advice.
We came for our kitten's vaccinations and check-up. The people were very friendly.

We have big dogs (45-plus kilos) and Dierenkliniek de Pijp came recommended from friends who also have a large breed dog. They were super right. Everyone is kind and accommodating -- and so knowledgeable. They are good about following up with phone calls about test results and scheduling appointments. Lorena in particular is the best vet I've ever had. She takes time to assess the situation, she checks the latest research, and she kindly and thoroughly explains everything. I'm so grateful that we can trust the care of our dogs to this clinic.
The vets here are excellent. They took great care of our dog and we got his rabies vaccinations and tapeworm treatment done here. Thank you team!

Charging €92 for a simple tapeworm treatment is absolutely ridiculous and absurd.

This is a routine procedure that takes just a few minutes, yet the price is completely unreasonable. It feels like taking advantage of people who need the treatment for UK travel documents. I would not recommend this clinic based on such excessive pricing.

We were going there for 2 years when we were living in Amsterdam. Our senior dog had an urgent discomfort and they quickly diagnosed and scheduled a surgery for the next day. All was successful and our dog recovered real quick. Thanks to everyone who is working there.
Amazing experience with their services. They listened to me and paid attention to all the concerns I had and took great care of my cat.
Love this vet!

I had taken time off specifically for this and went to this clinic by taxi with my two 4-month-old kittens. I had agreed on a price of €170 per cat by phone beforehand for a check-up, vaccination, and microchipping of the kittens.

The doctor only looked at their eyes, nose, and weight. She asked if my house was dusty, because according to her, there was too much dust around the kittens. She cleaned the kittens' eyes, during which a lot of dust and dirt came out of their eyes and noses. This subsequently ended up on the table, but the table was not cleaned. After that, she walked away.

The doctor came back and gave the kittens a small amount of cat treats. SHE PUT THE CAT TREATS ON THE SCALE. After that, they were weighed, and the check-up was essentially over. In my opinion, the hygiene in the treatment room was not good.

I had already dewormed the kittens twice, but the doctor still gave them two deworming tablets. Additionally, I was given eye drops for ten days. The bottle, which I believe contained 5 ml, was already almost empty after three days.

According to the doctor, the kittens were sick. That is why, according to her, they could not be microchipped or vaccinated. I do not understand why the microchipping could not go ahead. As far as I know, microchipping has nothing to do with whether or not a kitten is sick. I have my doubts about this as well.

Additionally, I had mentioned that one of the kittens had vomited four days ago. Apparently, the doctor did not consider this important and paid little further attention to it.

Ultimately, the appointment was finished within about 15 minutes. Only the eyes and ears were checked, the kittens were weighed, and I was given medication. In total, I had to pay €219.

I asked for an invoice. I did not receive one immediately; I was told that it would be sent by email. Four days have passed since then, and I still have not received an invoice.

I took time off work specifically for this appointment and also incurred taxi costs. I therefore find it very disappointing that the agreed vaccination and microchipping were not performed, even though that is exactly why I came to the clinic.

I understand that a vaccination sometimes cannot be given if a kitten is sick. But I find it strange that the microchipping was not done either. Additionally, I am concerned about the hygiene in the treatment room and the lack of clear explanation and an invoice.

My experience with this clinic is therefore very disappointing. It felt to me as if they were primarily looking out for money, while little time and attention was devoted to the kittens.😪
Scandalous service
I can’t imagine that there exist many vets who would send a handwritten postcard when your pet passes away. These people are unbelievably warm, kind, and consummate professionals 💕 …
Excellent service! The veterinarian was very professional and efficient. My dog was examined quickly and received great care. I highly recommend this clinic.
I definitely recommend them. They diagnosed my cat quickly and guided us through the subsequent treatment. Truly a great team.

DAY BONUSES!! It is moral when it comes to caring for your animal; when a veterinarian derives personal monetary benefit from treating animals, whether they need it or not, it is unacceptable. Fortunately, legislation is coming for this; until then, be wary of this veterinarian: I cannot post the link here, as there are multiple articles about this, and our House of Representatives is currently taking action against veterinarians like this one.

This veterinarian cares more about the wallet than about your animal; I would stay far away from them. After settling the bill, and after hours of scaremongering, I wasn't even told if everything went well or what the findings were. Bam, a bill of 340 euros. They don't make a fuss about that. They checked if my cat had farted, with a story they used to defend themselves as if I were an idiot. Be careful, because these people have completely lost their own moral values.

Of course, we're never happy about having to take our pets to the vet, but every time I've needed to, it's always been a good experience here. The separate areas for cats and dogs make everything even more comfortable for them. My cat Alice needed to be seen and undergo various treatments and exams, and she was always very well cared for, especially by Deyse. I always recommend the clinic to friends; it's a safe and reliable place 🖤 thank you for everything guys

I take my cat Gaia to the clinic since I moved to the Netherlands. The staff is super friendly and experienced, I'm very glad I found a clinic that I trust as an expat and have only great experiences so far. They have vets that speak Spanish, Portuguese, English and Dutch of course.

We've been bringing our dog Kiwi to this clinic about 4 years and have always had a great experience. The staff is friendly, caring, and very well organized.

Even after moving farther away, we still choose to bring Kiwi here because we completely trust the team and the care they provide.

One thing that really stood out to us was when Kiwi suddenly became very sick one morning. We hadn't been able to make an appointment, but they took her in right away and immediately started helping her. She was in really bad shape, and we truly believe their quick response and care may have saved her life.

We are incredibly grateful for everything they have done for Kiwi over the years and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate veterinary team.
Very kind and warm welcome visit

Dierenkliniek de Pijp is such a friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable business. Our 7 year old Frenchie loved being there and being treated like the demogoblin diva she is. ✨

The vets and staff working there went above and beyond in helping us, and we are so thankful that we found them. 🫶🏼

This is the 3rd veterinary clinic I've visited with my anxious dog, and the last one :) What friendly and dedicated staff! They are very thoughtful and take their time. Which is important for a dog like mine, who was adopted and is unfortunately anxious and stressed. Visits to the vet are never fun, but this way they become more bearable, for both dog and owner.
Amazing clinic, super professional and caring.
Wonderful clinic with a heart for animals and people
A very nice veterinarian who helps with love and attention.

I’ve been treating my dog at this clinic since he was born 6 years ago, and over time I’ve seen the level of service decline dramatically, including several incidents that were completely unacceptable. Today was the final straw for me. I arrived a few minutes late to an appointment and they decided to “punish” me by refusing to see us — despite the clinic being completely empty (!!!). They’ve completely lost their common sense.

As a long-time customer, I strongly do not recommend bringing your pets there.

A very nice and professional practice. We are especially happy with the special cat department. Our cats are always treated with great care, love, and professionalism. The guidance and communication are also very pleasant. Upon request, they can even come to your home. Highly recommended!

We went here multiple times with our cat Loki who broke his claw and had an infection from the injury. Loki also had to stay one day. Everything went smooth and the injury is healing well now. Everyone here is very compassionate and deeply cares for the animals. I’m still amazed by the separate cat waiting room. Communication via their app is great and even though we were seeing different vets they all were up to speed with his injury and background.

I guess the biggest praise is that Loki still doesn’t mind coming here, even after multiple vet visits and a stay over.

Very professional veterinary clinic. They even have a separate room for cats, so they don't have to wait with the dogs. All the staff are very kind to the animals and empathetic towards the owners. Our cat received excellent care, and we had good communication every time. Communicating via the app also works well.
Always very friendly and helpful, they take the time for you

Had a very positive experience taking Oliver to this clinic. He hurt his paw while doing the zoomies in the couch and the vet he normally goes to was closed because it was a Saturday. The Dierenkliniek de Pijp was able to squeeze him in the same day, take a look at his paw and treat it accordingly. The vet even did a more thorough analysis of the spine and legs and recommended some tests to make sure all is good due to his breed's predisposition. He’s 100% well now 😊❤️

We received excellent and friendly care here for our old cat. The veterinarians not only considered what would be best for the cat, but also what would be a pleasant process for us. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic; they handled everything very well and clearly.

I have nothing but praise for Dierenkliniek De Pijp. From puppy vaccines, to sterilisation and most importantly helping us move our dog across continents with various blood tests, we’ve always had the best service with super friendly vets and support colleagues. Thank you Will and Kim for making things run so smoothly and saving us a lot of stress!

I switched to this one from another veterinary clinic in Amsterdam, and I have been coming here with my dog ​​for years. The staff is incredibly patient, skilled, and empathetic. They always treat my dog ​​with love. I can only say that I am downright satisfied with the care.
Amazing! Amazing! How involved and understanding they are. Thank you for this.
My dog is very reactive to people but the vet named Will was wonderful. He has such a kind and calming presence, and we were able to do a check up without the usual drama. Definitely recommended.
Super friendly, super knowledgable English speaking vet! They have a dedicated wing for cats! Never been to a better vet.

Very happy with this veterinary practice!
My cat was in a lot of pain and is back to normal. The staff are very dedicated.

A fantastic welcome and a very trustworthy clinic. The veterinarians and their staff are dedicated, animal-friendly, and knowledgeable. The clinic isn't part of a chain, which guarantees individual attention and fair prices. And genuine advice. And the icing on the cake: they make home visits. So cool!

Evelien, Bea and other colleagues (apologies that I don’t recall all the names) were all extremely helpful from the point of the phone call, consultation and operation. Clean facilities, neatly organized and easily accessible by tram too.
I cannot thank you enough, our Tutu is purring and pleased- even after a castration. 😅 …

Fantastic veterinary practice! With so much attention and expertise, Bowie is always in the best hands here. The team really takes the time, thinks along with you, and radiates calm and confidence – for both animal and owner. Highly recommended! 🐾💙 …

We cannot thank Kyra and her team enough. They saved our cat’s life: while other clinics told us there was no hope, they kept looking for options — and thanks to them we got an extra 1.5 years with her. Forever grateful.

They were always caring, involved and kind to Inca and to us. When we sadly had to say goodbye to our cat, they handled everything with so much gentleness. 1000x thanks.

We would always choose Dierenkliniek de Pijp — and you should too!

Good afternoon. Could you please contact us? We do not recognize your name in our records, so we have no idea why this review was posted.

Kind regards,

Kyra de Keyzer,

Veterinary Clinic de Pijp

I feel very comfortable with this practice. All the veterinarians are dedicated and have specialized skills and equipment that allow them to do a lot themselves. Recently renovated and expanded, it looks professional, and the receptionists take their time. But most importantly, both my dog ​​and cat have gotten better.

Good afternoon,

Unfortunately, we cannot see which patient this concerns. We would like to discuss your concerns with you to determine the source of your dissatisfaction.

Kind regards,
Kyra de Keyzer
De Pijp Veterinary Clinic
Friendly staff.
Milly had a great experience at this Vet! Will definitely be continuing to come back!
The overall communication is not one hundred percent friendly. After being a customer for years, I now have a different veterinarian.
They are very friendly, even if you are new to the Netherlands they will help you a lot.
Always friendly. Kind to people and animals.

Place is great, always super helpful whenever I need help.

All the vets love dogs, you can tell the place  is good for your dog.

I want to start by saying the vets were really great, kind, professional, and clearly know what they’re doing. This review isn’t about them.
The problem has been everything around the actual care. I needed an echocardiogram for my cat, who has a serious heart infection, but the cardiologist is rarely available. Even though I booked the appointment 7 weeks in advance and arranged time off work, it was cancelled last minute. Communication was poor, and I didn’t get clear info until the very last moment.
They then referred me to a clinic two hours away from Amsterdam (by public transport) on a different day, which isn’t suitable for a sick cat. When I asked about rescheduling with them, the next available appointment was two weeks later, which just isn’t an option in his condition. The whole experience just made me very stressed

Terrible clinic. They've canceled appointments made well in advance twice, just before they were due. They said the ultrasound was urgently needed now, after stopping medication, but now they don't have an appointment for another three weeks. They don't offer an alternative.

Avoid!

I cannot recommend this clinic. I purchased special digestive food for my sick dog and the pack I received was mouldy. When I reported this, the clinic did not take responsibility and instead started blaming the brand of the food. They refused to schedule an appointment free of charge as a compensation for putting my dog at risk.

As a veterinary clinic, I expected accountability and care, especially when it comes to the safety of food for sick animals.

Unfortunately, this was not the case and I have reported the matter to the NVWA.
Very friendly, knowledgeable, amazing people work there. You can get an appointment quickly here, and they think along with you. Evelien, you are a star. Gucci and the Castermans family
Lovely people with so much care and attention for well being of the animals. Always a great experience and help.

Top notch! After reading many negative reports about veterinarians, this was a breath of fresh air. Understanding, expertise, and friendliness couldn't be better. Unfortunately, we had to have the cat put to sleep, but the way we were able to say goodbye was wonderful. Huge thanks to the veterinarian and staff member. TOP!
It's incredible how sweet everyone is here, to the dog, but certainly also to the owner.
I told them that he is a restless cat and he will take the cone off and lick the wound but the clinic didn't listen and postponed the appointment. Now my cat's wound is worse than before.
Highly recommended
Very friendly staff. Great service always available on the phone would definitely recommend it.
Such a beautiful clinic and the staff are so sweet! Super efficient as well!
Love from mishmish 🥹🤍 …
Best animal clinic in Amsterdam!
Quick and very informative l!

I ended up at this veterinary clinic because of its modern and neat location and initially had a good impression thanks to the friendly and young staff. Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing when a more complex medical problem needed to be addressed.

The clinic turned out to be unable to perform certain diagnostic tests themselves and referred them to the “Medical Center for Animals (MCD)”. On top of that, they charged a surcharge of €20 without a clear explanation. When I eventually contacted the Medical Center directly, I was told that all those tests were unnecessary. They emphasized that the clinic should have addressed the problem immediately, as delaying it was dangerous for my dog's health.

This approach not only resulted in unnecessary costs but also put my pet's health at risk. I had expected a higher level of professionalism, both in the treatment of the problem and in the communication with me as a client. I advise this clinic to be more transparent, avoid unnecessary referrals, and address problems directly and professionally.

My first visit at the clinic couldn’t have gone better. Both vet and front desk staff are very friendly and take the time to clearly explain everything in detail. Email communication is just as clear. As a first-timer I felt very comfortable and confident in the clinic, knowing my pet would be in safe, caring and competent hands.
Very good and friendly
Incompetent and unprofessional, and too expensive.

I want to share a truly wonderful experience I had with Dierenkliniek de Pijp. Recently, my dog and I were in desperate need. The owner stepped in with such kindness.  Honestly, I felt like she saved both our lives. Not only she did go above and beyond to help, but she did it all without asking for anything in return. They are incredible people who have been there for us. Their genuine love and dedication to animals is just amazing. I can’t recommend them highly enough; if you ever need a compassionate, caring clinic, they’re truly one of a kind.
Good people nice experience. Literally can't ask for more.
Dear staff, and beautiful veterinarian 🍀🦜👌🏻 …
Great care, attentive people!
